Despite these issues, the paper solves a real problem with a novel mechanism and demonstrates practical, deployable results that would allow practitioners to train models that currently OOM. The issues raised are "Minor" in severity; they do not invalidate the core findings but reduce the confidence in the precision of the accuracy claims and the completeness of the comparison landscape.
